doc.title: Jerry Bergonzi interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 7, 2022

title: Reincarnation, past lives and a psychic's prediction
summary: He discusses souls and past lifetimes, recalls studying stars in Peru, and a psychic who predicted a canceled trip when Brubeck's son fell ill.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: So if you believe that souls find a body and continue on, did you ever get any hint about what soul might have been passed to you? What kind of soul?

Yeah. The way you said the sentence is, to me, what soul passed to me. It’s like my soul, which they say souls are eternal and they say that they have hundreds of lifetimes. And you have to experience, this is the great teachers talking about reincarnation. You have to be a saint and you have to be a sinner. One lifetime you could be a hooker, the next lifetime you’re a doctor. You know you have to learn all the different aspects of life to get to the place where you don’t have to come back here anymore or whatever. But I don’t know about that stuff I’m just — that’s what they say. But have I had an inkling of past lifetimes? Yes I have. What I’ve meditated I kind of said yeah, wow. I just get an intuition about it you know.
Anything you feel like sharing? © Fillius Jazz Archive -8-

Well I can remember studying the stars in Peru and I’d even see the shape of the windows that I was — I mean where I’d go look at it, investigating. It was exactly what I saw. And another one I remember a woman who used to — I used to go to a psychic and she said to me, “You’re going to go on four trips this year but one’s getting canceled because one of the people in the band — you’re going overseas four times this year but one of the guys in the band is going to get sick.” And one of the guys did get sick, Dave’s son, and we canceled the trip. Dave Brubeck’s son. And she said, “You were a piano player in another life” which doesn’t surprise me you know. Things like that.
